Most churches teach that when you die, you either go straight to Heaven or Hell. But is that what the Bible really says?
In this powerful, verse-by-verse Bible study, we break down the truth using line upon line, Old and New Testament, and original Hebrew and Greek meanings — to reveal what truly happens after death.
Spoiler: The dead are asleep... until the resurrection.
“The dead know not anything...” – Ecclesiastes 9:5
“The dead in Christ shall rise first...” – 1 Thessalonians 4:16
“You will be with Me in Paradise.” – Luke 23:43 (but was it that day?)
Watch this full breakdown of what happens to the righteous and the wicked according to Scripture alone — not tradition.

1:32 — Bible over tradition: Why context and multiple verses matter  
4:01 — Common view: Spirit goes up, then back down, then up again?  
5:12 — When are the dead in Christ raised? Resurrection explained  
7:52 — Mainstream belief: Are the wicked already burning in hell?  
10:00 — What the Bible really teaches: The righteous sleep in death  
12:03 — Satan bound to the earth for 1,000 years  
13:34 — Judgment after 1,000 years: Saints return to Earth  
16:26 — Psalm 146:4 – “His thoughts perish”  
20:00 — What is a soul? Genesis 2:7 explained  
26:00 — James 2:26 – “Body without spirit is dead”  
30:00 — Job 14: Man dies, lies down, and does not rise… until Jesus returns  
33:00 — 1 Corinthians 15: Immortality is *given* at resurrection  
36:00 — Ecclesiastes 9:5 – The dead know nothing  
38:00 — Why necromancy is deception (talking to the dead)  
43:00 — John 3:16 – You *perish* or receive eternal life — not both  
47:00 — Parable of the Rich Man & Lazarus — literal or symbolic?  
51:00 — Lazarus is dead, not in Heaven (John 11)  
56:00 — What about paradise? Was Jesus in paradise *that day*?  
1:00:00 — Revelation 2:7 – The tree of life is in paradise *of God*  
1:02:00 — What about eternal hell? Let’s break it down
